title: Synology NAS owners: ransomware is hitting outdated DSM - update tonight
description:
Got a Synology NAS at home or work? Ransomware is hitting the outdated ones.

On October 29, 2026, Synology warned that attackers are exploiting a vulnerability it patched in December 2024, targeting devices still running outdated versions of its DSM operating system, to encrypt data and demand a ransom. Synology has not publicly named the exact flaw.

The Shadowserver Foundation tracks more than 380,000 Synology NAS devices exposed to the internet (not all of them are vulnerable). Victims report files renamed with a .L0CK3D extension and a ransom note, reportedly demanding thousands of dollars.

Analyst note: RAID is not a backup. If your NAS holds the only copy of your files, ransomware takes it all. Keep one copy offline.

Do this tonight:
1. Update DSM now.
2. Turn on automatic updates.
3. Block the DSM admin page from the internet; use a VPN for remote access.

Sources

- IT-Connect (Oct 29, 2026): https://www.it-connect.tech/c3rb3r-ransomware-is-hitting-synology-nas-devices-how-to-protect-yours/
